newsitem.title: SPAIN: SPAIN PROVINCE CULLS 20 PCT OF PIGS TO STEM FEVER.
newsitem.headline: SPAIN PROVINCE CULLS 20 PCT OF PIGS TO STEM FEVER.

text.p: A fifth of the pigs in Spain's northern Lerida province have been slaughtered to stem the spread of swine fever, which should be eradicated by September, the regional agriculture department said on Monday.
A spokesman for Lerida's agriculture services said 515,703 pigs had been killed out of a total of 2.5 million since the first outbreaks of the disease were reported in February.
"We expect to be free of the disease by September," the spokesman said. "We have already started opening some of the areas."
A total of 49 cases of swine fever had been reported in the province, the last being in the village of Alcarras early last week, the spokesman said.
Of a total 6,800 farms, 1,121 have had pigs culled.
